purpose: qualify a genuinely independent empirical dataset capable of testing whether conditional activity transfers after observation-process/detection nonstationarity is separately represented

parent_evidence.motivating_limit: E4 cannot identify ecological activity nonstationarity separately from source-specific effective detection because the annotated stream fixes detection at one while geography and source domain shift together

scientific_question: does explicit conditional activity contribute transferable predictive information when geography/source-domain structure and effective observation detection are not forced into one stationary activity channel?

required_public_or_reproducibly_accessib: deployment/site table with stable deployment and physical-location identifiers
deployment start and end timestamps sufficient to reconstruct effort
event timestamps with timezone or unambiguous local-time semantics

crossed_domain_design.rule: geographic regime and survey/source/protocol domain must be separable rather than perfectly confounded
acceptable_designs: at least two geographic regimes each represented by at least two source/protocol domains

one standardized source/protocol domain spanning both training and heldout geographic regimes plus an independent second source/protocol domain overlapping at least one regime for detection calibration
a paired/crossed design with simultaneous or matched deployments that directly contrasts source/protocol while holding geographic context approximately fixed

acceptable_paths: paired or replicated simultaneous sensors permitting relative detection estimation
independent calibration of camera/sensor detection or detection distance tied to deployment
repeated-visit observation design with a separately identifiable detection model
auxiliary observation stream that informs detection without consuming the ecological activity channel

predeclared_activity_structure.random_or_hierarchical_location_activity: allowed only if frozen before response opening and identified by qualified physical replication

negative_controls.nonfocal_taxa_selection_rule: freeze abundance-independent eligibility using taxonomy/schema/exposure only before focal response opening where possible; if response counts are needed for minimum-data qualification, those thresholds and taxa pool must be frozen before inspecting direction
negative_controls.purpose: detect source-wide diel/detection shifts that are not focal-taxon-specific

pre_response_gates.pass: candidate is a new response dataset not used in E2-E4 or Snapshot Japan empirical openings
deployment identity, physical location, effort interval, event time, taxon identity and source/protocol metadata are present and parseable
geography and source/protocol are not perfectly confounded under one of the declared acceptable designs
at least one declared auxiliary/replicated calibration path separately informs effective detection
minimum independent physical-location counts and strict heldout geography are available
training and heldout exposure overlap across sufficient months and day/night effort
activity, detection, source/geography-by-diel and season-by-diel structure are frozen before focal heldout outcomes

candidate_decision.selection_rule: among pre-response-qualified candidates, prefer the design with the strongest detection-identification path and crossed-domain geometry; do not rank candidates using focal outcome direction or predictive gain

claims_if_eventually_qualified.maximum_pre_outcome_claim: design-qualified independent test of activity-vs-detection transfer
